politics.title: Prioritise new jobs over green targets to win public contracts, firms told
politics.summary: The changes are part of government efforts to tackle the youth unemployment crisis.

politics.title: Police chief considers joining legal action over PC Harper killers' early release
politics.summary: Two of PC Andrew Harper's killers are set to be included in the government's early release scheme, which begins in October.

politics.title: Burnham considers reversing plan to scrap some jury trials
politics.summary: The prime minister says his "instinct" is to reverse plans by the last PM to limit jury trials in England and Wales.

politics.title: High Court upholds decision to allow Chinese mega embassy
politics.summary: The government has given the green light to the site on the old Royal Mint, near the Tower of London.

politics.title: Infantino 'wrong man' to lead Fifa says Burnham as criticism grows
politics.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham says Gianni Infantino is "the wrong man" to lead Fifa as criticism grows of the controversial investment plan.

politics.title: Burnham faces criticism over plans for mayors to get share of income tax
politics.summary: Tory mayor Lord Houchen wants to offer a rebate, but the prime minister says it should be reinvested in communities.

politics.title: MP Diane Abbott readmitted into Labour Party after suspension
politics.summary: The long-serving MP apologises for past comments and says she has been issued with a "formal warning".

politics.title: Burnham 'looking into' conducting Epstein inquiry, says victims minister
politics.summary: Alex Davies-Jones tells BBC Newsnight she discussed an inquiry with the PM when she was re-appointed as minister.

politics.title: Tories offer Jewish groups meeting with ex neo-Nazi activist candidate
politics.summary: Joshua Bonehill-Paine was jailed over neo-Nazi activism, but has been selected to stand in a new Somerset Council seat in 2027.
